messages:
sara: Heads-up — seeing repeated tail latency spikes for several dedicated pools in us-west-2 since ~03:10 UTC. Affected tenants are mostly high-egress workloads.
liam: Yep saw that too. Trace looks like network egress burst + slow kernel tx completion on a subset of nodes.
chun: Which pools exactly? dedicated-gpu-slice-{a,b,c}?
sara: primarily dedicated-gpu-slice-b and some ephemeral slices mapped to that AZ. Not all tenants on the slice.
noah: Possible noisy-neighbor at NIC level. Could be qdisc/backpressure + our proxy queueing.
maria: Ops-bot alerted a pattern: "egress-rate > 3Gbps sustained -> 99th p99 token latency jump" for those pools.
ops-bot: [alert] 03:12 UTC us-west-2: dedicated-gpu-slice-b egress burst detected (3 tenants). See /runbooks/egress-throttle for mitigation steps.
liam: Can we confirm whether this correlates with tenant KV-cache warmups? high kv read rates can spike egress too.
sara: quick grep on recent traces: two tenants show repeated large model downloads (quantized weights) right before spikes.
chun: paste logs:
```
node-ugw-12 kernel: tx_queue_stop called, txq full
proxy-gpu-101 proxy: downstream write timed out after 250ms
netd: egress throttle applied=0
```
noah: That kernel line suggests NIC transmit ring saturation. Could be large sustained MTU flushing from evicted connections.
maria: If it's NIC-level, pinning tenants to dedicated NICs or per-tenant egress policing could help. But dedicated pools were supposed to avoid noisy neighbors...
liam: Right — the isolation boundary we have is at allocator + slice level, but NIC/host-level shared resources still leak.
sara: Proposed short actions: 1) throttle offending tenant egress at proxy (soft limit) 2) schedule rolling rebind of impacted workers to alternate racks 3) collect perf counters for next 24h (ethtool stats, qdisc)
noah: I can push a soft egress cap via envoy config for the three tenant routes. Command: `kubectl -n proxy rollout restart deploy/proxy-route-config` and patch envoy filter to set token bucket.
chun: We'll need to coordinate with capacity so we don't trigger canary fails. Add fallback policy to route to quantized-model variant.
liam: Also add a short-term scheduler tweak: avoid colocating those tenants' hot tasks on same NICs — use `--prefer-different-nic` flag in allocator for the canary window.
maria: Cost note: moving traffic or rerouting to other racks may increase cross-az egress and costs. Callout to finance: small short-term cost will avoid customer-facing latency.
sara: I'm going to run the following quick query to tag impacted nodes and start telemetry: `curl -s "https://telemetry.internal/api/query?metric=egress_bytes&pool=dedicated-gpu-slice-b&since=1h" | jq .`
noah: After we throttle, we should enable per-tenant KV-cache prewarming to reduce repeated model downloads. That will lower egress long-term.
chun: For the larger mitigation plan: 1) formalize per-host NIC isolation options (vfio/vfs), 2) add egress rate shaper in allocator, 3) improve our capacity model to include NIC headroom.
liam: +1. Also add an automated rollback: if proxy throttle causes >0.5% error rate increase, auto-lift for that tenant and notify SRE.
maria: I'll message finance and product about potential cost impact and tenant communications.
sara: OK team — no full customer outage but noticeable p99 regressions. Action owners: noah (apply soft thrift on proxy) chun (schedule rebind + telemetry collection), liam (scheduler tweak + rollback hook), maria (stakeholder comms). We reconvene in 40m. :eyes: 
ops-bot: [task] create incident-incident-ticket #INC-2026-egress-burst auto-created for follow-ups.
noah: starting envoy patch now, will post diff.
liam: grabbing allocator patch branch, will run canary in staging in 10m.
sara: thanks — please drop short status updates here.
noah: envoy patch applied, soft throttle at 2.5 Gbps for tenant-42 and tenant-87. Monitoring p99...
chun: rebind jobs submitted to different racks, ETA ~15m.
maria: FYI prod comms drafted, waiting on final latency numbers.
liam: canary allocator change looks good in staging; planning staged rollout to 10% of nodes in the slice.
sara: last update before meeting: p99 latency improved ~30% on impacted tenants after throttle and rebind. Still collecting NIC counters.
noah: posted envoy diff: https://git.internal/repo/patches/egress-soft-throttle-4076543210
sara: good work. We'll follow up with a short RFC for long-term NIC isolation and egress-aware allocator changes.
liam: add ticket to backlog: "per-host NIC headroom model + egress shaper".
maria: noted.
sara: meeting in 5.
